how_to_read: entities: new entities in the strokes format, ready to copy into a part (as S4's merge_fixes accept()). retire: entities to drop in merge_fixes.mjs, with the reason. changes: edits to existing entities; 'set' keys are fields or 'pts.<name>' points, 'add_note' is text to append to the note, 'conf' is the confidence of the proposal itself. checked: the merge notes' list for this range (gen/map/S2/merge_notes.md, 'Second pass', row east) and my own sweep, read again on the scan, with no change proposed. Crops are in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ran-3d-director/5a5a3bca-3a69-416d-986a-71fd47398c96/scratchpad/S2_second_east/ (ng.mjs: gridless contrast-stretched crops with border ticks every 20 px; crop.mjs: the same with a grid; i_*.jpg: tools/scroll_inspect.mjs scan over restyle; ov*_*.jpg: scroll_map overlays of the merged map).

entities.name: two straight stems behind the long top roof, west of the willow (a small tree, faint)
entities.what: Two straight, dark, nearly parallel stems rising from behind the east end of the long tiled roof at the top of the silk to the silk's top edge, about 15 px apart; their crown is above the silk and their foot behind the building: a small tree (or a forked trunk) standing behind the roof, west of the willow S2.tree.willow_27925.
entities.vis: part: only the stems between the roof's top edge (v ~50) and the silk's top edge (v ~18) show; foot behind the roof, crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: SECOND PASS (east): not an entity; t10 folded these strokes into S2.tree.willow_27925's crown ('whips hang over u 27800-27995', crown_w (27800, 40)). Strokes (zoom 5, scratchpad S2_second_east/z_stems.jpg): west stem u 27778-27788, east stem u 27794-27800, both from the silk's top edge (v ~18) down to the roof's top edge (v ~48-52), even in width over their length, of the same dark ink as the trunks nearby. TWO READINGS: (a) a separate small tree behind the roof (recorded); (b) the westmost hanging whips or branches of S2.tree.willow_27925 (the restyle paints hanging willow whips here, i_stems.jpg). For (a): the stems are 6-10 px thick, 2-3 times a willow whip's width on this scan (the whips behind the 望楼饭铺, n_willow2.jpg, are 2-4 px), straight and parallel; between them and the willow's trunk complex (u ~27860-27960, n_toptrees.jpg, n_willow27925.jpg) the silk at u 27805-27855, v 20-50 carries only faint dabs, no branch joining them. Base est where the roof hides them, as for the other trees here; the true foot is north of the building (S2.bld.top_long_house_27560's east end; t10's 'north shed'), a builder choice:. The tree count matters to the user: drop it if the lead reads whips. Crops: scratchpad S2_second_east/z_stems.jpg, n_toptrees.jpg, n_willow27925.jpg, i_stems.jpg.

retire.reason: Not a second person in either reading that the strokes allow. The mark (u 28554-28569, v 1304-1321) is 14 x 17 px, solid dark, with no light face, outline or body of its own on the zoom-6 crop; it sits 15 px east and 20 px below the flat-topped upright S2.fig.boatman_coils_28543. changes.add_note: Second pass: conf low -> med. It is a man leaning on the rail and looking down to the west, not a knot of poles. Points unchanged (head 27650, 282 is the cap's top; the face's middle is about (27648, 296)).

The dark band (u 28589-28610) runs continuously from the silk's top edge (v ~22) down through the far roof's band (v 37-78) and across its eave line (v ~78-84) to v ~130, tapering, with a fork at its top. changes.add_note: Second pass: conf low -> med for the tree reading, as for S2.tree.far_tree_28603: its dark bands (u 28620-28660) start inside the far roof's band at v ~55 and run down across the eave line (v ~80) to the rounded dark mass at v 125-150, so it stands in front of the building, not under its eave. The rounded mass at its foot stays open (a shrub, a swollen base or a rock). The restyle paints a second trunk and a round bush here.

Second pass: still one man or a bitt (conf low kept). The dark upright is 11-13 px wide (u 28537-28550) with a flat, two-lobed top at v 1280-1290 and a narrower dark stem down to v 1316, dark all the way, with no lighter face below the 'cap'. The heads of the figures painted at this size nearby are 17-33 px wide (the bank porter 25 px, the shed keeper 26 px), which favours a bitt; the restyle paints one man in a black cap with his hand raised to his face exactly here, which favours a man. See the retirement of S2.fig.boatman_coils_28562.

Second pass: still open (conf low kept). On a gridless zoom-2.5 crop the blob (u 27877-27907, v 1222-1246) is dome-topped with a flat brim, over a lighter patch at v 1246-1266 just above the tiller bar (v 1266-1278): it reads like a capped head over a face.
